_about: Pep's training library: short sessions a player can do with no gym and little kit.
A session = warm-up + one or two drills for the player's focus areas + cool-down. 'needs' lists the kit: nothing, ball, wall, cones, friend(s).
'areas' links a drill to skill areas in skill_areas.json. 'film' = Pep can count it if the player films it (a standard test in drills.json).
Football opinion: review with coaches. Pep never prescribes through pain: light and rest days exist for that.

warmup.name: Warm-up
warmup.how: Jog, skips, side steps, open and close the gate, then three short runs at half speed.

cooldown.name: Cool-down
cooldown.how: Walk for a minute, then stretch calves, hamstrings and hips. Drink water.

light.name: Easy touches and stretching
light.how: Gentle ball touches on the spot, then slow stretches. Nothing should hurt: stop if it does.

drills.name: Weak-foot wall passes
drills.how: Stand 2 m from a wall. Weaker foot only, ankle firm, 20 passes. Step back to 5 m and repeat.

drills.name: Scanning rondo
drills.how: 3 against 1 in a small square. Look over your shoulder before every touch and say what you see: 'turn' or 'man on'.

drills.name: Shoulder checks against a wall
drills.how: Pass to the wall. Before the ball comes back, look over one shoulder, then the other. Receive on the half-turn and go.

drills.name: Keepy-up ladder
drills.how: Feet only, then thighs, then head. Count your best in a row each round.

drills.name: Tight dribble through cones
drills.how: Five cones 1 m apart. Inside and outside of both feet, ball never more than a step away. Shoes or bottles work as cones.

drills.name: Turn and go
drills.how: Dribble, stop the ball with the sole, turn and accelerate 5 m. Both directions, both feet.

drills.name: Falling starts
drills.how: Lean forward until you have to step, then sprint 10 m with short, fast steps. Walk back. 8 times.

drills.name: 30 m sprints
drills.how: Six sprints of 30 m with a full walk back between them. Fast, not tired.

drills.name: 5-10-5 shuttles
drills.how: Touch the line each turn, stay low through the change of direction. Six reps, rest between.

drills.name: Box-to-box runs
drills.how: Run at a steady pace for 1 minute, walk 1 minute. Six rounds. You should be able to talk.

drills.name: Ready stance and react
drills.how: Knees bent, weight on your toes. A friend points left or right; push off that way for 3 m. 20 reactions.

drills.name: Low dives
drills.how: On soft ground. Set your feet before each shot, then dive low to each side. 10 each way.

drills.name: Show for the ball
drills.how: In a small game, move into space after every pass and call for the ball. Count how often you get it.
